about.bio: I'm Karan, a Network Engineer focused on building, securing, and troubleshooting real-world networks. I work with technologies like routing, switching, VPNs, and network security across enterprise environments. This blog is where I share hands-on labs, configurations, and practical insights from my daily work — no theory overload, just real networking.
